openings.claim: Common allowance may cause size-dependent rework; check the first saleable ordered cover per size before releasing remaining cutting.
openings.discriminator: Recurring size-linked dimensional errors under comparable operator, design and direction support allowance correction; inconsistent errors weaken it. Subsequent comparable covers test reduced resewing.
openings.fit: Uncertain: corrected layouts, calibration and validation must satisfy stock, waste, budget and delivery constraints.
openings.probe: Record order, cut and sewn dimensions, operator, design, direction and stage times. Measure offcut length and width through five washes. Check fit, wash survival and layout waste by area before releasing corrections; count trial and coordination labor.
openings.uncertainty: First units may mislead; cloth and operator effects unresolved. Small-cover timing does not establish batch feasibility; weight-estimated waste does not establish area compliance.

openings.claim: Actual table dimensions or corner geometry may explain customer failures despite reference-table fit.
openings.discriminator: Compare measured dimensions and corner profiles separately; failure on dimension-matched rounded tables supports an independent corner effect.
openings.fit: Measurement preserves constraints; any pocket revision requires validation.
openings.probe: Obtain dimensions and corner outlines from six willing customers, prioritizing nominal-only orders. Pair reference fit with observed first placement; compare similarly dimensioned tables with different corners. Validate resulting revisions for ordered design, tool-free removal and five-cycle survival.
openings.uncertainty: Customer accuracy, informative comparisons and timely participation unknown; missing matched comparisons remain inconclusive.

decision: Probe both; causes and 38/40 placement, all-design and 32-minute targets remain unproven. Honor ordered sizes/designs; use purchased stock with <=8% area waste, two machines, <=350 units and three weeks. Include all measurement labor; require five-cycle survival and tool-free removal.
